guide.thedarkdimensions.burned_stick: Flint and Steel + Stick → Burning Stick (shapeless). Returns the igniter with 3 durability consumed; it breaks when exhausted. Holding the stick deals fire damage. Throw it into water → Burned Stick.
guide.thedarkdimensions.improved_stick: Throw a Burning Stick into water → Burned Stick. Burned Stick + normal Stick → Improved Stick (shapeless).
guide.thedarkdimensions.fire_core: Eight Blaze Powder surrounding one Empty Runestone craft a Fire Core.
guide.thedarkdimensions.improved_amethys: Still craftable from one amethyst shard, one diamond and seven glass panes. The old ore no longer generates; Essentialium is a separate geode resource.
guide.thedarkdimensions.improved_echo_sh: Surround an Echo Shard with 8 Improved Amethyst. Right-click a discovered Improved Obsidian frame in the Burned Realm to open the Echo Depths. Echo Relics in ruins drop Echo Shards.
template.thedarkdimensions.base_slot: Insert a tool or Perfected Netherite Spear
template.thedarkdimensions.addition_slot: Insert Improved Stick or Improved Diamond Spear
guide.thedarkdimensions.improving_templa: Smithing: Improving Template + Diamond/Netherite tool + Improved Stick. Keeps enchantments, name and wear. Improved Diamond tools upgrade further with Netherite Upgrade Template and Netherite Ingot.Find the first template in Nether fortresses (20%) or Bastions (20%, treasure chests 35%). Duplication only: 7 diamonds + existing template + Crying Obsidian → 2 templates.
guide.thedarkdimensions.double_spear: Smithing: Improving Template + Perfected Netherite Spear + Improved Diamond Spear. 8 jab damage, +2 blocks reach, stronger kinetic attacks and enchantability 25.
guide.thedarkdimensions.glowing_honey: Harvest Glowing Bees with a glass bottle (30 second cooldown), or obtain as a drop. Drink for 60 seconds of Glowing; the glass bottle is returned.
guide.thedarkdimensions.spelltable: Blank Spellbook + Core at the Spelltable binds an element. 39 spells across eight element trees. Each new skill costs one Chronus Infused Ingot and the displayed predecessor level. 8 / 20 / 40 / 70 successful uses grant levels 2 / 3 / 4 / 5. Green nodes are learned or affordable; hover gray nodes for missing requirements. Click to learn, hover and press 1–5 to assign. Master books have element tabs and five shared mixed slots. Open book, spellwheel and cast use separately configurable keys. Blank book: Book + Runestone + Metalinium. Master book: four Elemental Cores, two Essentialium, two Chronus Infused Ingots and a blank book. Bind additional elements using cores at the Spelltable.
gui.thedarkdimensions.free: Choose a spell • No level cost
guide.thedarkdimensions.surface_lights: Luminous crystal outcrops grow on dry terrain in the dark dimensions. Harvest their light-emitting stones with a pickaxe.
guide.thedarkdimensions.katanas: Frostgleam: 6 damage, 1.5 speed, Frosted for 4s. Bloodgrief: 8 damage, 1.5 speed, Blood for 5s (lethal, milk-resistant). Souleater: 11.5 damage, Soulless for 3s. +2 blocks reach. Creeperblood: one item, 5% drop chance.Blood Essence: 1 Creeper Blood or Zombie Blood + Gold Ingot. Bloodgrief requires 2 Blood total for its two Blood Cores.All special katana recipes now use a Basic Katana instead of an Improved Stick.
guide.thedarkdimensions.fish_axes: Smithing: Improving Template + axe + any raw or cooked fish. Normal axe stats and tool use; preserves enchantments and wear.
guide.thedarkdimensions.hammer: 10 damage. Crafting: diamond / diamond block / diamond; lightning core / Improved Stick / lightning core; empty / Improved Stick / empty. Only the Awakened Hammer grants held Elytra gliding. Awaken with Lightning Core as template, hammer as base and Lightning Spellbook as addition. Right-click: aimed lightning strike with a five-second cooldown.
guide.thedarkdimensions.blood_netherite: 4 Creeperblood + 2 Netherite Ingots → 1 Blood Netherite Ingot. Smithing: Bastion template + Netherite equipment + Blood Netherite Ingot. Duplicate with template + 7 diamonds + Nether Wart → 2 templates.
guide.thedarkdimensions.devils_trident: Smithing: Devil’s Tear template + Trident + Devil’s Eye. Craft each with eight Creeperblood around Ghast Tear / Eye of Ender. 8 damage, Blood (5s), fire (4s), Devil’s Charm (5s). This Trident also enables Riptide in lava.
guide.thedarkdimensions.devils_armor: Devil’s Armor I on all four worn Blood Netherite armor pieces: fire/lava immunity and water-like swimming in lava. Missing or unenchanted pieces disable the bonus. Available from enchanting, books and villager trades.
guide.thedarkdimensions.reinforced_stick: Burned Stick + normal Stick → Improved Stick (shapeless). Used for improved tool handles, katanas and other handle recipes.
guide.thedarkdimensions.astral_crystal_w: Fire Core above a Ghast Tear above an Improved Stick. Available before the End; upgrades a complete obsidian portal frame.

guide.thedarkdimensions.basic_katana: Two diagonal iron ingots above an Improved Stick. Five damage, 1.6 speed, normal sword reach. Foundation for all six special katana recipes; supports parry, dodge and Slashing.
guide.thedarkdimensions.mindshifter: End Crystal + Basic Katana + Shulker Shell, shapeless. 8.5 damage, 1.5 speed, +2 reach. Right-click fires a homing Shulker projectile: five damage, five-second cooldown, three durability. Safe impacts exchange positions without levitation. Sneak + right-click to parry. Aim range 24 blocks; swap range up to 32 blocks. Blocked/unloaded destinations, liquids, unsupported ground, mounts and vanilla end bosses prevent swapping; confirmed hits still deal damage. Repair with Shulker Shells.Found as rare treasure only in End Cities (4%). Earlier pre-End treasure locations are removed.
guide.thedarkdimensions.hellsblade: 9.5 damage, 1.4 speed, +2 reach. Crimson Rupture: hits leave up to two red fissures on the target, owned by the attacker and expiring after four seconds. The third combo hit ruptures them for two magic damage per fissure (2–4), without fire or terrain damage. Multiple callbacks in one swing cannot duplicate the pulse. Existing recipe and rare treasure locations are retained.
guide.thedarkdimensions.end_progression: Nether → Burned Realm → three cave trials → End. Portal wand: Fire Core / Ghast Tear / Improved Stick vertically. Completing the three distinct trials permanently unlocks Eyes of Ender for the world. Then: Ender Pearl + Blaze Powder + Essentialium → Eye of Ender. Also works in a Crafter; previous trial receipts migrate from older saves.

guide.thedarkdimensions.spell_branches: Fire: Fire Bolt → Ember Mark → Inferno; Fire Bolt → Ash Step → Fire Ring → Fire Guard. Water: Water Heal → Tidal Wave → Frost Bind; Water Heal → Water Veil → Water Guard → Healing Spring. Lightning: Lightning Strike → Static Charge → Chain Lightning → Storm Field; Lightning Strike → Lightning Step → Thunder Leap. Chronus: Dash → Rewind → Time Anchor; Dash → Time Slow → Inertia Field or Afterimage → Stolen Moment. Ender: Ender Chest → Rift Step → Void Pull or Ender Ward → Dimension Fold. Five advanced capstones join two branches; hover for their additional requirements.
guide.thedarkdimensions.spell_tactics: Ember Marks charge through three of your fire hits; level five needs two. Inferno consumes your marks. Static Charge prioritizes chain-lightning targets and enables telegraphed Storm Fields. Healing Spring supports you and teammates. Cast Time Anchor again to return: placement cooldown one second, return up to nine seconds. Stolen Moment: prepare, then Perfect Dodge within eight seconds; the next successful spell has a 35% shorter cooldown, or 50% at level five. Preparation cooldown one second, internal recovery twelve seconds. Dimension Fold: aim at the upper face of safe ground; crouch inside a passage. Two temporary passages in the same dimension, up to twelve blocks apart. Spells never change terrain or load chunks.

guide.thedarkdimensions.spell_mastery: Each of the 39 spells has two mastery branches at level 5. Click its tree node, then choose a branch. The first choice is free; changing costs one Chronus Infused Ingot in Survival and is free in Creative. Right-drag pans the tree; the mouse wheel moves vertically. All connected prerequisites must be met. A small native bar below the crosshair shows the shared spell cooldown; a quiet crystal chime signals readiness.
